name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.5.0 Studio Super Update!
• Lossless 100% Quality IMG PASTE button (imports clipboard image directly to Project Icons bin & timeline)
• Fixed Premiere Pro insertion bug (eliminated comp error by synchronous host appId detection)
• Automatic 'Icons' folder creation on disk and 'Icons' bin in Project panel (Pr & Ae)
• Clean folder dropdown showing only folder names (path retained in tooltip)
• Category pills auto-slide and center smoothly when clicked
• Fixed SVG stroke clipping: borders never cut or crop even at maximum thickness
• Brand new 1st tab: Recent (tracks recently used emojis, icons & pasted images)
• Merged Custom Playlists into Folders (2nd category option)
• Save custom icons/emojis to local linked folders with instant subfolder creation
